**No.** The evidence covers ASSET-B, not the surrounding region, so it cannot establish whether forest loss occurred region-wide.

Within the asset, Hansen data records historical tree-cover loss, including 67.7 hectares in 2020. After the 2020 baseline, it records 0.4 hectares of loss in 2021 in patches below the 0.5-hectare event threshold. The JRC reference mapped no forest on the asset in 2020.
